id: qc-02
title: IBM utility experiment
paper: Kim et al., Evidence for the utility of quantum computing before fault tolerance (Nature 618, 500, 14 Jun 2023)
link: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06096-3
type: Benchmark
cutoff: 2023-06-14
domain: qc
profile: advantage

## expected_verdict
Conditional limitation (split). Error-mitigated expectation values on 127 qubits are accurate where they can be checked: Supported. The "beyond classical" framing is not: within two weeks, belief-propagation tensor networks and sparse Pauli dynamics reproduced the same observables, more accurately and faster.

## I0
Can error mitigation estimate observables of a large kicked-Ising circuit accurately?

## evidence
- Device: ibm_kyiv Eagle, 127 fixed-frequency transmons; circuits up to 60 two-qubit layers, 2,880 CNOTs; Trotterized 2D transverse-field Ising (kicked Ising) on the heavy-hex lattice, angle θ_h swept.
- Mitigation: sparse Pauli-Lindblad noise learning, noise amplification, zero-noise extrapolation (linear and exponential); PEC judged too costly at this scale.
- Verification: Clifford points (θ_h = 0, π/2) exactly checkable; light-cone and depth-reduced circuits; mitigated values match ideal out to 20 Trotter steps at Clifford points (Fig. 2).
- Hard regime: magnetization and weight-10/17 observables at non-Clifford θ_h; claims MPS and isoTNS "break down" while hardware gives correct results (Fig. 3–4).
- Authors' framing: "evidence for utility", explicitly "not … problems with proven speed-ups".

## intake
- Scope: (A) ZNE-mitigated expectation values on a 127-qubit noisy processor are accurate; (B) in the strongly entangled regime they exceed what leading classical approximations deliver.
- Regime: kicked Ising on heavy-hex, 5–20 Trotter steps, specific low-weight and mid-weight observables.
- Assumptions: learned Pauli-Lindblad noise model is stable; ZNE extrapolation is unbiased enough; MPS/isoTNS represent the best classical methods.
- Falsifiers: for B, a classical method matching or beating the hardware accuracy at modest cost; for A, deviations from exact values at checkable points.

## screen
- Must flag: classical comparators were limited to MPS and isoTNS; heavy-hex geometry is tree-like; near-Clifford angles favour Clifford-based simulation; no hardness argument for these observables.
- Must request: observable-specific classical methods (Pauli propagation, belief-propagation tensor networks).

## retrieval
- Pre-cutoff must-finds: ZNE and PEC (Temme, Bravyi & Gambetta 2017; Kandala et al. 2019); sparse Pauli-Lindblad noise learning (van den Berg et al. 2023); MPS and isoTNS methods cited as comparators.
- Current mode: Tindall et al. 2023: belief-propagation tensor network on the heavy-hex lattice, "significantly more accurate and precise" than the processor, incl. the thermodynamic limit; Begušić & Chan 2023: sparse Pauli dynamics on a single laptop core, orders of magnitude faster than the hardware walltime, agreeing with ZNE results.

## designer
- Compare hardware ZNE values with multiple classical methods (MPS, isoTNS, BP tensor networks, Pauli propagation) on identical circuits and observables, at matched error tolerance; record wall-clock for each.

## champion
- Sparse Pauli dynamics (Begušić & Chan) and BP-tensor-network simulation (Tindall et al.): both exploit the observable and lattice structure.

## panel
- Flaw: "beyond brute-force" is not "beyond classical". Repair: restrict claim B to the methods tested; keep claim A.

## run
- Reproduce a Clifford-point check and one non-Clifford magnetization curve with a Pauli-propagation simulator (laptop-scale per Begušić & Chan); hardware data from the paper's repository.

## verdict
- Label: A Supported; B Refuted for the reported regime (classical methods match).
- Must say: the mitigation accuracy result survives; utility as "beyond classical" does not for these circuits.
- Must not say: the experiment was wrong; or error mitigation is useless.

## audit
- Check: 127 qubits, 60 layers, 2,880 CNOTs; 20 Trotter steps; both rebuttals dated June 2023; Begušić & Chan citation missing from the S2/OpenAlex index (confirm in PDF; inventory note).

## variants
- Observables or geometries (higher-weight, non-tree lattice, deeper circuits) where BP and Pauli propagation fail to converge.
